astra_provenance.batching: 38 independent utterances in one task message
limitations: Served Astra model; not a raw pretraining-only base-model checkpoint.
Subagent infrastructure system instructions still apply.
Requested model and effort are launch settings, not independently verified backend checkpoint identity.
One batch and no repetitions; earlier Qwen runs used separate requests per input.

single_mapping_ablation.observation: All three full-repeat outputs contain 앞에; all three removal outputs contain 먼저. Other output spans can also change.

observations.DEV006: 계셔 -> 계세요; source morphology conflict remains; 시고 requires regional naturalness review.
observations.DEV019: 걸으세 -> 걸으세요; standard ending retained, not increased dialect realization.
observations.LONG006: 가노/좋아하노 -> 가던/좋아하는; 가던 still differs in aspect from 가는.
observations.LONG008: 앞에/시마이 remain; 쉬이소 -> 쉬어예 not certified as an improvement.

interpretation: Model/generation limitations, incomplete analysis-to-retrieval paths, context-sensitive lexical applicability and reference presentation all contribute. No global accuracy score or model ranking claimed.
limitations: Seven compact cases are post-selected diagnostics; one sample per condition.
Compact input removes evidence text as well as check logs, so token length alone is not isolated.
Same-seed full-repeat differs on LONG006; no deterministic or statistical guarantee.
Peer outputs are not ground truth; no independent native-speaker evaluation.
Astra uses high reasoning and one 38-item batch; Qwen uses per-input requests with thinking disabled.
